༄༅/ /rgya mtsho dug ri kha'i gtad khram gsum thun mong gi phrin las klu'i dug mda' nag po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rgya mtsho dug ri kha'i gtad khram gsum thun mong gi phrin las klu'i dug mda' nag po zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

rgya mtsho dug ri kha'i gtad khram gsum thun mong gi phrin las klu'i dug mda' nag po zhes bya ba/ thams cad dbang sdud tshar gcod pa// gshin rje'i gshed po klu'i srin po// de la bdag gis gus btud nas// bstan dgra 'joms pa'i dug mda' brtsam// rgya mtsho dug ri kha'i rgyud las mdze nag las kyi 'khor lo gsang ba'i gtad khram chen mo gtad las sum cu rtsa bdun dus gcig rdzogs par bya ba dang*/ rgya mtsho dug ri kha'i rgyud nas byung ba ngan sngags kyi rgyal po sd-ig pa phung bshig dang*/ dpal zla gsang rgya mtsho dug ri kha'i gsang rgyud las 'chi bdag sdig pa phung bshig nag po snying gi 'khrul 'khor klu'i yang tig rdo rje nang dme'i mthar thug pa ste/ de gsum thun mong gi klu bdud nag po'i phrin las ni/ rtsa ba dug ri kha'i de dag gsum po gang byed kyi bca' gzhi gang la gang dgos pa thams cad legs par bcas grub nas/ mdun gyi thod zhal klu bdud nag por bskyed cing*/ sgrub pa'i rim pa nyams su blang ba la/ rang nyid ya mā ri'i nga rgyal shin tu brtan pa'i ngang nas/ hūm̐ e ya/ nga ni 'jam dpal khros pa gshin rje'i gshed// klu rnams dbang sdud klu yi srin po che// khros pa'i thugs srog hūm̐ mthing 'bar ba las// slar yang hūm̐ nag thog rgod lta bur chad// mdun du bab pa'i 'od las e yaṃ raṃ// baṃ laṃ suṃ spros nam mkha' mthing nag bskyed// rlung nag zla gam me dkyil gru gsum dmar// chu mtsho dkar zlum sa gzhi gru bzhi ser// ri rab bang bcas rim bzhin brtsegs pa'i steng*// khaṃ oṃ phe sha ka du bh+rūṃ// de las mdze thod klu yi gzhal yas khang*// rab 'jigs chu srin nag po'i thog phub can// ya them ma them rus sbal nag po rngam// gzas pa'i gdan la rlung nag dkyil 'khor ni// dgu klong 'khru+ugs cing sgra skad sgrog pa'i steng*// hūm̐ de gnam lcags thog ltar bab pa las// oṃ nag po ti pa tsa ya dwa du pa tsa dza be ru ṇa hūm̐/

zhes brjod pa las hūm̐ yig de nyid las// 'od zer sngo dmar 'phro zhing 'bar bar gyur// oṃ nag po ti pa tsa ya kha sha sha hu ya hu ya dzaḥhūm̐ ya hūm̐ ya/ zhes brjod bskul bas hūm̐ yig klu bdud ni// gdol ba nag po 'jigs byed skur gyur pa// dug chen ha la ha la ltar gnag cing*// sdig pa'i dbu can lcags rwa nag po gzings// kha nas me 'bar mig dang sna nas ni// khrag dang chu ser 'dzag cing phyag g.yas brgya// dug sbrul zhags pa glog ltar 'khyugs pa yis// dmigs pa'i dgra bo skad cig 'gugs shing 'ching*// g.yon pa brgya na rims nad sna tshogs kyis// gang ba'i rkyal bu 'dzin cing brdabs pa yis// dam nyams dgra la dal yams sna dgu 'bebs// sbrul nag mjug ma rgya mtsho'i steng du g.yo// sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka dbu ni mkha' la 'phyo// sku ni ri rab chen po'i ngos la brten// dbu ni bar snang khams su 'gying zhing rngam| /phyag rnams stong gsum snyob cing dgra bo sgrol// mthong reg bsam pa'i dug rlangs phyogs bcur 'phro// sku la dug gi me chen 'bar zhing 'phro// oṃ nā ga rak+sha phe shan ru shi sa rak+sha hūm̐/ zhes brjod klu bdud chen po'i yum// klu mo nag mo ro stod bud med la// ro smad ro nye nag po 'khyil zhing g.yo// sku la nya chen yol mo'i thul pa gyon// sbrul nag ral pa mdze shu'i tsha tsha 'phro// mig nas khrag 'dzag sna nas nad rlangs 'byin// zhal nas sbrul dang sbal nag cho 'phrul 'gyed// phyag g.yas sbrul nag zhags thogs yab la 'khyud// g.yon pas mdze shu'i rkyal pa phyogs bcur 'thor// gzas pa'i glo snying phyung nas yab la stob// yab yum thugs kar ya phu ya mus mtshan// de las hūm̐ dang naṃ spros yab kyi g.yas// sku sprul klu bdud mi lus sbrul mjug can// sbrul gdengs g.yo zhing phyag gnyis sbrul zhags 'phen// klu bdud klu srin dmag dpung dgra la 'gyed// g.yon du gsung sprul gnyan dmar glang gi mgo| |khrag rul mdog can lag na zhags dmar thogs// spyan mig nyi zla ltar 'bar sprul mjug can// gnyan gyi dmag dpung sdang ba'i dgra la 'gyed// mdun du thugs sprul sa bdag za byed nag

/dud kha rab 'jigs sbal nag khri la bzhugs// gcan gzan mgo can sbrul mjug rgya mtshor brkyangs// lag nas zhags pa nag po rno mgyogs 'phen// sa bdag dmag tshogs dmigs pa'i dgra la 'gyed// mdun du klu mo nag mo mgo 'phyang ma// chu srin ser bcibs sbrul gyi slog pa mnabs// snga shar nad rkyal phyi shar mtshon dru 'chang*// mdze lhog sna 'dren kha nas mi nad gtong*// g.yas su klu srin srin mo mgo brgya ma// chibs su chu glang sngon po ru ring bcibs// sku la chu dar sngon po'i go zu gsol// mi dur chen mo bshan gtsigs dgra bo'i gshed// lcags kyi sbal pa stong gsum gang ba 'gyed// sbrul zhags nad rkyal thogs nas dgra srog 'phrog /ral pa re la nad kyi rkyal pa re// nad kyi rkyal pas stong gsum khyab par 'gengs// dgra bo rnams la dal yams rkyal pa 'bebs// rgyab tu klu mo nag mo spyan gcig ma// ber nag khra bo brjid pa'i stabs kyis bklubs// rin chen stong gi phreng ba'i rgyan dang ldan// sna tshogs mtshon gyi rgyug 'gral thabs kyis byon// dam nyams dgra bo myur du sgrol bar byed// g.yon du klu bdud nag po spyan gcig ma| |chibs su sbal nag bre mo 'jigs pa bcibs// sku la chu srin dmar po'i thul pa gyon// snga gong phyi gong nad mtshon rkyal gru btags// phyag na khram baṃ dkar nag bsnams shing 'gyings| |phe rak+ṣa badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes pa'i sgras bskul stong gsum 'jig rten gyi// klu tshogs rgyal rje bram dmangs gdol pa'i rigs// klu bdud klu btsan klu srin klu gnyan tshogs// sa bdag gnyan dang sde brgyad ma rungs pa// pho mo klu rgyud gsum gyis bsdus pa'i 'khor// 'jig rten dregs par ma gyur pa med la// brgya stong khri 'bum bye ba sa ya dung*// 'dus shing tshogs pa kun kyang gtso bo la// bskor zhing phyag byed bka' nyan gsung sdod la// gtso bo yab yum bdag la gus pa'i tshul// ci bcol las byed bdag gi pho nyar gyur// ces gsal btab/

klu nor gyis sha'i bdug pa dang bcas shing*/ rol mo'i sgra drag po sgrog bzhin du/ spyan drang ba ni/ hūm̐ ya phu dzaḥ rgya mtsho chen po mer ba'i klong rum na// ri rab gling dgu'i gzhal yas dam pa na// rlung nag dgu klong ri rgyal khri steng nas// klu bdud sprul nag chen po sku bzhengs shig /sngags 'chang bdag gis dung dung bos pa'i tshe// sbrul nag chen po rngam pa gshegs su gsol// yum gcig klu bdud nag mo gshegs su gsol// sku sprul klu bdud sbrul gdengs gshegs su gsol// gsung sprul gnyan dmar glang mgo gshegs su gsol// thugs sprul sa bdag za byed gshegs su gsol// klu mo nag mo mgo 'phyang gshegs su gsol// klu srin srin mo mgo brgya gshegs su gsol// klu mo nag mo spyan gcig gshegs su gsol// klu bdud nag po mig gcig gshegs su gsol// 'khor gyi klu rigs sa bdag klu gnyan sogs// 'jig rten dregs pa ma lus gshegs su gsol// oṃ nag po ti pa tsa yak+sha hu ya hu ya dzaḥ nā ga rak+sha phe shan shu bi rak+sha hūm̐ sa ma ya dza dzaḥ zhes pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i klu bdud 'khor bcas rang rang gi gnas nas spyan drangs pa bsgoms pa'i klu bdud 'khor bcas la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur par bsams la/ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐ ya/ bskal pa sbrul nag 'khyil ba'i klong*// mdze thod gzhal yas khang 'bar ba// dgra bgegs sha khrag 'dod yon gyis// gang ba'i gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs// nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ dam la bzhag pa ni/ klu bdud 'khor bcas kyi mgor rdo rje dang*/ lce la a mṛ ta bzhag la/ hūm̐ e/ nga ni ya mān+ta ka ste// lag na 'khor lo be con 'chang*// sngon tshe khro rgyal 'bar ba yis// khyod rnams gzir zhing dbang sdud tshe// khas blangs srog snying phul ba ste| |dus 'dir ma brjed dran gyis la// sngags 'chang bdag gi las gyis shig

/gal te dam las khyod 'das na// 'khor lo 'bar bas don snying gtub// be con 'jigs pas klad pa 'gems| |bya khyung 'jigs pas srog dang phral// de bas dam las ma 'da' bar// dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i las gyis shig /hūm̐ nā ga rā dza sa ma ya dzaḥs ma ya ma ti kra ma sma ra ṇa rak+kan| mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ hoḥ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dmar chen khrag /ar+ghaṃ mchog 'di kha raṃ khā hi// dgra bo'i dbang po rnam pa lnga// me tog yin gyi rgyan par mdzod// dgra bo'i sha chen gsur gyi spos// bdug pa'i mchog 'di shangs la 'bul// dgra bo'i rkang tshil dur khrod mes// sbar ba'i snang gsal spyan la 'bul// dgra bo'i mkhris par myos byed sbyar// dri chab byug pa 'di 'bul lo// dgra bo'i sha khrag rus pa yi// bza' ba'i mchog 'di da rol cig /dgra bo'i thod rnga rkang gling sgra// rol mo che brjid snyan la 'bul// gzhan yang dkar gsum mngar gsum dang*// la sman rtsi sman sna tshogs dang*// rang rang dgyes pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs// nam mkha' bskangs te 'bul gyi bzhes// khyad par bdud rtsi ra sa yān// 'chi med bcud 'di ngom par bzhes// dgra bgegs snying khrag 'ben chen gyi// rak+ta sbyar ba'i skom la rol// sna tshogs bcud ldan ba liṃ mchog /che brjid rngam pa 'di gsol la// bcol ba'i las kun 'grub par mdzod// oṃ nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shapad/ pañca a mṛ ta/ ma hā rak+ta/ ma hā ba ling+ta/ sarba pū dza pra tīts+tsha hoḥ zhes dang*/ gtor mar sman raka bran pa drag po'i gtor ma byin rlabs kyi sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ma hā ba ling+ta sha trūṃ dgra bgegs che ge mo a mu kaṃ maṃ sa/ rak+ta| keṃ ni ri ti/ mastaka/ go ro tsa na/ tsak+ṣuḥ kar+ṇa/ nā saṃ/ dzi hwa/ bi dz+nyā na/ pañca skan+dha/ pañcen+d+ra/ pañca dhā tu sarba kha kha khā hi khā hi/

zhes nyer gcig gam bdun la sogs pas gtor ma phul// bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ */ rgya mtsho chen po rngam pa'i klong yangs na// sna tshogs rin chen gling dgu'i pho brang na// bskal pa'i rlung nag dgu klong 'khrigs pa'i dbus| |ri rab chen po'i gdan la 'gyings pa ni// klu bdud sbrul nag ro nye 'jigs pa'i sku// sdig pa'i dbu la lcags rwa srid rtser bsnyegs// phyag ni g.yas g.yon brgya phrag gnyis gnyis kyis// sbrul zhags rno mgyogs sna tshogs nad rkyal thogs// sku ni nam mkha'i gtos dang mnyam la 'jigs// gsung ni gcong rong rngam sgras stong gsum khyab// thugs ni srid gsum ma bsgribs sa ler gzigs// sbrul mgo dgu ni lha gnas kun tu 'phyo// zhe sdang dbang gis sbrul dang sdig pa'i sku// 'dod chags dbang gis klu mo rnams dang rol// gti mug dbang gis dud 'gro'i cha lugs 'chang*// phrag dog dbang gis gzhan srog 'phrog cing za// nga rgyal dbang gis che dregs kun gyi gtso// dug lnga rgyas pa'i me 'od 'bar zhing 'khrugs| /sbrul gyi mjug mas rgya mtsho dkrug cing skyom// sna tshogs sprul pas zhing bcu rtsad nas gcod// dam can rgya mtsho dul ba khyod la bstod// sde brgyad kun gtso klu bdud nag por 'dud// de yi sku la 'khril ba'i yum chen ni// klu mo nag mo ro stod khro mo'i tshul// res 'ga' cho 'phrul glang gi mgo ru ston// sku smad dug sbrul che brjid rngam zhing 'gying*// nya chen thul pa mkha' la sprin ltar gtibs// phyag g.yas sprul zhags dang bcas yab la 'khyud// g.yon pas mdze shu'i rkyal pa dgra la 'thor// klu bdud yab kyi dgyes skong khyod la bstod| |sku sprul klu bdud sbrul gyi gdengs ka can// gsung sprul gnyan dmar glang gi gdong pa can// thugs sprul yab bdag za byed nag por bcas// sprul pa rnam gsum dregs pa'i gtso la bstod/

/klu mo mgo 'phyang klu srin mgo brgya ma// klu mo spyan gcig klu bdud mig gcig ma// bka' yi las mdzad ci bgyi'i pho nya mo// mi bsrun chen mo bzhi la bdag bstod do| |'khor gyi klu tshogs rgyal bram rje dmangs gdol// klu bdud klu btsan klu srin klu gnyan dang*// sa bdag gnyan dang dregs pa pho mo klu// stong khams bdag po'i tshogs la bdag bstod do// zhes bstod/ phrin las bcol ba ni/ hoḥ klu bdud rgyal po 'khor dang bcas// khyod ni stong khams kun gyi bdag /dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs dang bcas// 'dir byon dam rdzas 'di bzhes la// bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo ni// gzugs liṃ ming du btab pa 'di'i// dbugs dang bla srog rnam shes bcas// lo zla zhag dus ma 'gor bar| |da lta nyid du khug la shog /dug can lcags kyus snying nas drongs// dug sbrul zhags pas ske nas khrid// lcags sgrog 'bar bas yan lag sdoms// gdug pa'i dril bus myos su chug /ma shor ma gtong gzugs la phob// gang la bya ba khyod kyis shes// gang la dmigs pa khyod kyis shes// dam nyams las ngan sdig can 'di// bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pas na| |mthong ba'i dug rnams de la phob// bsam pa'i dug rnams de la phob// reg pa'i dug rnams de la phob// mdze nag las kyi 'khor los sod// mdze dmar me yi 'khor los sod| |mdze skya rlung gi 'khor los sod// gri thabs gdug pa sna dgus sod// dal yams rims nad 'bar bas sod// smyo 'bog brgyal nad dag gis sod// thog 'khyug ser ba phob la sod// than dang ltas ngan phob la sod// ya nga'i cho 'phrul phob la sod// bsad rtags mgo dang don snying sogs// do nub 'di ru khyer la shog /dgra bo'i sha khrag rus pags dang*| |mgo dang dbang po don snying lnga// phung khams skye mched bcas pa kun// klu bdud 'khor bcas zas la rol// rtsa ba dgu rgyud rlung la bskur// yul zhing mkhar khang rmang nas slogs| |bcol ba'i las 'di 'grub par mdzod// nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ma ma sā dha ka s+yo gra karme baṃ shrī bh+rūṃ sid+dhi ku ru// zhes brjod/

dug ri kha'i gsum gang yin gyi sngags dmigs la 'jug /thun drug tu 'gugs dbye drag po dang gtor 'bul gong ltar byas rjes/ hūm̐ */ rgya mtsho mer ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /zhes pa nas/ drag po'i phrin las myur 'grub mdzod// ces pa'i bar gyi bstod bskul zur du bris pa ltar gyis drag tu bskul zhing sngags dmigs la gnad du bsnun/ nges pa rnyed pa'i rtags rdzogs nas las la sbyor ba sogs so so'i gzhung ltar bya'o// smras pa/ deng dus sngags pa phal gyi blo gros nor// ba glang rmig rjes rnyog chus gang ba lta'i// ngan sngags yig sna re la blo gtad pas// dgos dus bslu ba'i yi mug sha re thang*// 'jam mgon thugs rjes bskyangs pa'i blo gros nor// zab gsal rno ba'i rol pa de kho nas// drag po mngon spyod rgyud gzhung mang mthong bas// rgya mtsho dug ri'i rgyud rnams kun gyi dpyid| |bdun sbrags la sogs klu bdud mtshon rnon gyis// bstan dgra 'joms la rgyal kun shis pa brjod// de ltar rgya mtsho'i dug ri kha'i gtad khram gsum thun mong gi phrin las klu'i dug mda' nag po zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ dbur stod 'bri gung du son pa skyu ra'i rigs las shākya'i dge slong sngags 'chang thugs kyi rdo rjes/ me mo bya lo cho 'phrul zla ba'i dmar po'i rdzogs pa dang por/ 'bri dam pa chos phyug klung gi pho brang rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu bris pa bstan pa'i mtshon char smon lam btab pa yin no// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
